title: dactylorchis maculata var. immaculata
intro: Dactylorchis maculata var. immaculata, commonly known as the immaculate spotted orchid, is a variety of flowering plant in the orchid family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorchis maculata var. immaculata include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
